title: Interactive latency-routing explainer & step-through map tiles
creator: Maya Ortiz
description: Create a set of onboarding/quickstart visuals and short explainer assets for region and latency routing. Deliverables include a step-through map sequence for the quickstart page, a simplified technical diagram for the docs (how requests are routed by latency and fallback rules), responsive screenshots for mobile and desktop, and export-ready artboards for the docs site. Designs must account for light/dark console themes, clear accessibility contrast, and alt text for each visual.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Map sequence (3 states) exported as SVG + PNG at @1x and @2x and uploaded to Drive and docs CDN
A2: Technical routing diagram (PNG + PDF) that matches console copy and shows primary/secondary fallbacks, model variant routing, and region selection
A3: Mobile-optimized screenshot set (320px and 480px widths) demonstrates condensed legend and tap targets
A4: All visuals include authoring alt text, short captions for docs, and a single-line tweet-friendly blurb
A5: Design reviewed and signed off by PM and ENG with resolved accessibility feedback
tasks: Sketch initial 3-state map flow in Figma (tiles: nearest-region, cross-region fallback, degraded QoS)
Design technical explainer diagram showing routing policy precedence and KV cache hints
Create responsive artboards: desktop (1200px), tablet (768px), mobile (375px)
Export assets: SVG, PNG@1x, PNG@2x, PDF for print
Write alt text and single-line captions; add to assets manifest
Upload exports to Drive folder and link to docs PR; push images to docs CDN branch
Coordinate with ENG to capture product screenshots of regional routing toggle in console
Record a 6s autoplay GIF demonstrating routing fallback in action for the quickstart header
alt_texts: Map showing nearest region highlighted with green pin and latency overlay indicating <20ms to nearest region
Mobile screenshot with condensed legend: shows fallback region selected and latency estimate of 85ms
Routing debug panel listing policy precedence: user region -> latency-based -> reserved-capacity fallback
review_feedback: PM (Nora Patel): Prefer explicit labeling of fallback tiers and a short callout sentence under the map; remove jargon for quickstart
ENG (Samir Rao): Diagram should call out model-variant fallback and show KV cache warm path separately; confirm kernel-labels are not included in public doc
Accessibility (Priya Singh): Increase color contrast on latency heatmap; provide patterned overlays for users with color blindness; ensure 16px readable type on mobile screenshot
decisions: Use Mercator-based tile visuals for consistency with other docs maps
Color palette: green (#22B573) for primary, amber (#FFB020) for fallback warning, slate (#475569) for offline/degraded
Provide two deliverable sets: simplified onboarding map (user-facing) and detailed technical diagram (docs-facing)
GIF will autoplay but include an accessible play/pause control in the docs implementation
